verdict.rationale: Ironclad has a first-party guide for embedding the Ironclad Signature experience for a signer inside an iframe [ironclad-docs-36]. It also documents embedding clickwrap acceptance in your own pages once a Clickwrap Workflow is published [ironclad-docs-6, ironclad-docs-14, ironclad-docs-22], which together cover the core of in-app signing. Missing for 10: detailed evidence on the embedded signing flow (signer session/auth handling, UI customization, completion events tied to the embed) and independent or hands-on corroboration that embedded signing works as documented.
